scope: The early exterior silhouette of the original Tōkai Power Station in Ibaraki, with the block-shaped main hall, long adjoining industrial hall and banded 89 m chimney seen in the Department of Energy archival photograph.

originalReview.notes: The exact Qualla original matches the United States Department of Energy archive image HD.15.058 and the Commons transfer and license record. The model draws on its historic concrete and chimney silhouette and the parallel broad-roofed hall.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with Qualla’s exact published original and matched it to the native public-domain government archive record. The original alone establishes the historic exterior appearance.
